generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The tenderer should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least one financial years minimum financial turnover in all cases civil engineering construction work only of rupees not less than the estimated cost under this contract amount put to tender inclusive of GST i.e, Rs.58.50lakhs.Turnover, Profit & Loss account, Balance sheet statement certified / audited by a Chartered Accountant along with UDIN to be submitted. The UDIN is mandatory on all financial certificates
The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed any construction work to an extent of 25percentage of the cost of the work i.e.., Rs.14.62lakhs 25percentage of amount put to tender inclusive of GST
Profit & loss Account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by Chartered accountant
